signs.say: Walk along the platform to the elevator. About 220 steps.

signs.sign: To Mezzanine · L & Downtown N Q R W
signs.say: Take this elevator up one level, to the mezzanine.
Go under the Elevator to L sign and into the long corridor. About 20 steps.

signs.sign: Long white corridor with ad screens
signs.say: Walk the length of the corridor. About 90 steps.
Go past the yellow columns. About 15 steps.
Do not go out at these turnstiles. Keep going, about 25 steps.
Go on through the hall with blue columns to the wide exit gate. About 35 steps.
Go out through the wide gate and follow the arrow. About 25 steps.

signs.sign: Red Exit sign, NE corner, beside the orange mural
signs.say: Take the elevator under the red Exit sign up to the street.

signs.sign: Climate Clock above Best Buy, across 14th St
signs.say: You are out, at 14th Street and 4th Avenue. The Climate Clock is across the street.
